questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Andorra?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Overview” part of the Andorra article.

questions.proof: The capital is Andorra la Vella.

questions.prompt: What money is used in Andorra?

hints.nudge: Money names often come from a country’s own words. The other three are spent in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the part of the article about the economy, or at the facts for the country.

questions.proof: The money used in Andorra is the euro.

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find Andorra on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find Andorra on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Andorra?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Andorra on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Andorra article.

questions.proof: Andorra, officially the Principality of Andorra, is a landlocked sovereign country located in the eastern Pyrenees Mountains of Southern Europe and bordered by Spain and France.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: Andorra about 468 square kilometres; Malta about 316 square kilometres; Saint Kitts and Nevis about 272 square kilometres; San Marino about 61 square kilometres.
